India Accuses Pakistan of Lies at UN on Jammu and Kashmir

India has accused Pakistan of peddling lies and falsehoods at the United Nations concerning Jammu and Kashmir. During a UN session, India's representative directly challenged Pakistan's narrative, asserting that Jammu and Kashmir is an integral part of India. The Indian statement aimed to counter what it termed "lies and falsehoods" presented by Pakistan.
